svg.title: Clan War 1000 v 1000
svg.desc: Two sanghas of a thousand agents meet in a game world. Each side has one Strategist, a few Captains and many squads of fighters. Inside each sangha, orders go down and scouting reports come up, and neighbouring squads assist each other. A Herald carries terms between the two Strategists, so even rivals keep their agreements and their honour. Cooperation is scored within each side and across both.
